topic: Can the proposed lens designs mitigate congestion in X-band by enabling efficient reuse of Ka-band spectrum through enhanced spatial isolation?
consensus_response: The proposed lens designs can enhance spatial isolation, enabling efficient reuse of Ka-band spectrum. However, this may lead to increased interference between beams, reducing capacity and QoS degradation. Adaptive Modulation and Coding (ACM) techniques can mitigate rain fading effects, but introduce additional complexity and cost due to the need for real-time signal processing and adaptation. Phased Array Antenna Calibration is a critical component in achieving high-precision beamforming, which can compensate for the limitations of diffraction-limited beamforming. However, this introduces additional complexity and cost due to increased phase errors and reduced beamforming accuracy.
reference_context: Satellite systems are moving from C and Ku bands to Ka band to enhance spectral efficiency, but face challenges with adverse weather conditions and spectrum scarcity.
